Definition: a form of G2491; Joannas, an Israelite:--Joannas.
BiblicalUsage: Joannas is one name in the genealogy Luke traces from Jesus back to Adam. In Luke 3:27 he stands between Rhesa and Zerubbabel, a link in the line that runs through the kings after the exile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name like Joannas is there to be counted, not skipped: the line to Christ runs through men history forgot, and Luke wrote every one of them down.
